name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-yantao-desktop
description: Electron shell for the yantao workbench: spawns the dsh host as a child process and shows the workbench in its own window (ADR-0016)

scripts.refresh: pnpm -w run yantao:refresh && echo Refreshed. Quit the workbench from the tray, then run "pnpm start" again.
